visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tab bar switching topic content panels
visualCharacteristics.layout: Ruled, horizontally scrolling tab bar with an underlined active tab; one panel below at a time
notable: A panel can be a fragment or page link, loaded with loadFragment on first open

contentPattern.structure: One row per tab: label cell and panel cell (rich content, or a single link to a fragment / page whose blocks form the panel)

usage: Use to group parallel topics (e.g. licences, locations) on one page.
reuseGuidance: Fits 2-8 tabs with short labels; tabbed-content covers tabs driven by section metadata.
